svg.title: Thirty Days to an Operationally Ready Restoration Pod
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-first-thirty-days; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Thirty Days to an Operationally Ready Restoration Pod; subtitle: Four weekly milestones establish evidence, capacity, and cash controls.; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values are milestone end days. The canonical time to first deal is 1–5 months; this sprint establishes readiness and does not assume a paid job within thirty days. Monthly operating costs span $4,000–$20,000 depending on deployment.; caption: Use simulated job files until authorized customer work is available; never fabricate loss evidence, invoices, or insurer responses.; stages: label: Days 1-7; value: Jurisdiction, scope, and cash plan; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Map contractor and remediation credentials, define public-adjusting boundaries, select the startup budget, and build a thirteen-week cash forecast separating operating costs from direct job commitments.; label: Days 8-14; value: Pod, equipment, and safety readiness; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Assign two employee and two contractor core roles, verify qualifications and worker classification, secure equipment access, and document hazard assessment, respiratory protection, and emergency escalation procedures.; label: Days 15-21; value: Evidence and billing rehearsal; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Run a simulated water-loss file through dispatch, photo capture, psychrometric readings, Xactimate scope, customer authorization, job-cost coding, and invoice reconciliation; resolve missing evidence before live use.; label: Days 22-30; value: Referral activation and measured deployment; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Contact targeted property managers and referral partners, track the inquiry cohort, and accept only authorized work within capacity. Review weekly cash exposure, receivable aging, safety events, and job contribution.

text.title: Thirty Days to an Operationally Ready Restoration Pod
text.tspan: Thirty Days to an Operationally Ready Restoration Pod

circle.title: label: Days 1-7; value: Jurisdiction, scope, and cash plan; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Map contractor and remediation credentials, define public-adjusting boundaries, select the startup budget, and build a thirteen-week cash forecast separating operating costs from direct job commitments.

label: Days 8-14; value: Pod, equipment, and safety readiness; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Assign two employee and two contractor core roles, verify qualifications and worker classification, secure equipment access, and document hazard assessment, respiratory protection, and emergency escalation procedures.

label: Days 15-21; value: Evidence and billing rehearsal; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Run a simulated water-loss file through dispatch, photo capture, psychrometric readings, Xactimate scope, customer authorization, job-cost coding, and invoice reconciliation; resolve missing evidence before live use.

label: Days 22-30; value: Referral activation and measured deployment; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Contact targeted property managers and referral partners, track the inquiry cohort, and accept only authorized work within capacity. Review weekly cash exposure, receivable aging, safety events, and job contribution.

text.title: Assumptions: Numeric values are milestone end days. The canonical time to first deal is 1–5 months; this sprint establishes readiness and does not assume a paid job within thirty days. Monthly operating costs span $4,000–$20,000 depending on deployment.
text.tspan: Assumptions: Numeric values are milestone end days. The canonical time to first deal is 1–5 months; this sprint establishes readiness
and does not assume a paid job within thirty days. Monthly operating costs span $4,000–$20,000 depending on deployment.
